rust_summary: world views (`native_world_views`, `native_world_view_drawn`): the world drawn again from a mod's own cameras into targets of their own.
doc_summary: world views through `native_world_views` and `native_world_view_drawn`: as each frame is built a client mod may ask for up to four views of the world, each from a camera of its own (position, yaw, pitch, roll, field of view) at a size of its own; each is drawn with the frame's terrain, sky and entities into its own target, which `native_world_view_drawn` hands back with the device and the frame's encoder to draw into, sample or copy out ([World views](#world-views)). A frame without one costs nothing more. Bundles need "hooks": @API:world_views@.
